mapper.select: SELECT team.id, team.team_name AS teamName, COALESCE(leader.nick_name, leader.user_name, '未分配') AS leaderName, COUNT(DISTINCT tm.user_id) AS memberCount, COUNT(DISTINCT task.id) AS runningTaskCount, COALESCE(SUM(job.asset_count), 0) AS weeklyOutput, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(report.pass_rate)), 0) AS qualityRate, team.status FROM label_team team LEFT JOIN sys_user leader ON leader.user_id = team.leader_id LEFT JOIN label_team_member tm ON tm.team_id = team.id AND tm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_task task ON task.team_id = team.id AND task.deleted = 0 AND task.status <> 'completed' LEFT JOIN label_job job ON job.task_id = task.id AND job.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_qc_report report ON report.task_id = task.id AND report.deleted = 0 WHERE team.deleted = 0 GROUP BY team.id, team.team_name, leader.nick_name, leader.user_name, team.status ORDER BY team.id

SELECT team.id, team.team_name AS teamName, COALESCE(leader.nick_name, leader.user_name, '未分配') AS leaderName, team.status FROM label_team team LEFT JOIN sys_user leader ON leader.user_id = team.leader_id WHERE team.deleted = 0 AND team.id = #{id}
SELECT leader_id FROM label_team WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_team (team_name, leader_id, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{teamName}, #{leaderId}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_team SET team_name = #{teamName}, leader_id = #{leaderId}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT tm.id, tm.team_id AS teamId, u.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name, u.user_name, tm.team_role AS teamRole FROM label_team_member tm JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tm.user_id WHERE tm.deleted = 0 AND tm.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY tm.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_team_member (team_id, user_id, team_role, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT u.nick_name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.assignee_id = u.user_id THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.assignee_id = u.user_id AND DATE(j.update_time) = CURRENT_DATE() THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.assignee_id = u.user_id AND YEARWEEK(j.update_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.reviewer_id = u.user_id THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS review FROM label_team_member tm JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tm.user_id LEFT JOIN label_job j ON j.deleted = 0 AND (j.assignee_id = u.user_id OR j.reviewer_id = u.user_id) WHERE tm.deleted = 0 AND tm.team_id = #{teamId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nick_name ORDER BY total DESC, review DESC
